description.value:
Carved of the finest bloodwood, this staff is an elegant walking stick with a sharp metal point at its base. Fanged staves are popular among favored mortal retainers of vampires. While wielding a fanged staff, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against void effects.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Daze]

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Command], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Grim Tendrils]

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Blood Vendetta], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Draw Blood]

  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Enthrall], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Vampiric Feast]

  • 4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Sanguine Mist], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Vampiric Maiden]

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
